subject.title: [Bug]: Unscheduled reminder guard fires for isolated-session crons + counter lost during compaction

question: Should maintainers adopt or replace the open conflicting cross-repo fix candidate for this issue, or clear the no-new-fix-pr state and allow a fresh target-repo repair?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible and narrow, but ClawSweeper should not create another fix PR while the issue is explicitly linked to an open conflicting fix candidate without maintainer direction.

options.title: Replace with a fresh target-repo fix
options.body: Open a new narrow OpenClaw PR against current main that preserves the useful shape from the cross-repo attempt without carrying its stale/conflicting branch state.

options.title: Adopt and update the cross-repo PR
options.body: Ask a maintainer or contributor to rebase and adapt the existing cross-repo PR to current file paths and proof requirements before review.

options.title: Leave waiting on the cross-repo PR
options.body: Keep the issue open but continue blocking new repair work until the existing conflicting PR is made viable or closed.

recommendation.title: Replace with a fresh target-repo fix
recommendation.body: Open a new narrow OpenClaw PR against current main that preserves the useful shape from the cross-repo attempt without carrying its stale/conflicting branch state.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the current session-key reminder guard behavior that this issue extends, so they are the best code-history routing candidate among the available signals.
